p: That thou shalt take of the: By this ceremony they acknowledged that they received the land of Canaan as a free gift from God.
place his name there: To be called upon, served and worshipped spiritually, De 12:5.
Syrian ready to perish was my: Meaning, Jacob, who served 20 years in Syria.
and populous: Only by God's mercy, and not by their father's deserving.
cried unto the LORD God of: Alleging the promises made to our fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
brought the firstfruits of the land: In token of a thankful heart, and mindful of this benefit.
house: Signifying that God does not give us goods for ourselves only, but to be used also by those who are committed to our charge.
say before the LORD thy God: Without hypocrisy.
transgressed thy commandments: Of malice and contempt.
according to all that thou hast: As far as my sinful nature would allow: or else as David and Paul say, there is not one just, Ps 14:3, Ro 3:10.
all thine heart: With a good and simple conscience.
And the LORD hath avouched thee: Signifying that there is a mutual bond between God and his people.
